name: MakerWorld
author: David Reed
description: MakerWorld (Bambu Lab) activity in your Omarchy bar and as desktop notifications. A bar pill shows your point balance and an unread badge; its popup lists recent comments, replies, likes, followers, and system messages, opens any of them on makerworld.com, and can mark everything read. A headless service polls your Bambu Cloud account on an interval and raises a notification for anything new. Unofficial - it uses the same endpoints the Bambu Handy app does, so you sign in once with the bundled makerworld-login helper.

barWidget.description: Point balance and unread badge for your MakerWorld account, with a popup of recent activity and desktop notifications for anything new.

schema.label: Desktop notifications for new activity: on or off
Notify for which categories (comma list): comment,reply,like,follow,system,points - or 'all'
Auto-dismiss notification after N seconds (0 = notification-daemon default)
Sound file to play on each notification (blank = silent)
Max notifications per check (1-20), so a backlog can't flood you
Clicking a notification opens the page: on or off
Show the point balance in the bar pill: on or off
Log raw API responses to the shell log: on or off
